test_list.description: RestartIntensity::default() is 3 restarts per 10 s (chatlog value).
With max_restarts = N the first N requests are Allowed (with a running count) and request N+1 inside the window is Exceeded.
Restarts older than the window stop counting, so a restart is allowed again once the oldest one aged out.
A restart exactly `window` old no longer counts (half-open window [now - window, now)).
max_restarts = 0 reports Exceeded on the first failure.
A refused restart is not added to the history, so refusals cannot extend the lockout.
For any non-decreasing failure times, the accepted restarts inside any window of length `window` never exceed max_restarts.
